limitations: n2 per mode, fixed reversed order, six simulated seconds, one150bodyCI scenario; no inferential confidence or desktop limit.
GC tracing can perturb collection; light events are not unobserved gameplay. No subtracted overhead or predicted optimization savings.
State reset is not a heap reset; import/warmup garbage and fresh-worker lifetimes affect collections.
Positive heap reductions are collected/churn observations, NOT allocated or retained bytes. Detailed NVP inter-GC allocation is a proxy, no source-stack ownership/leak conclusion.
GC shares across threads and prior exclusive phases must not be added. Linux CPU brackets retain residual skew; exports are outside useful windows.
